description: Instructions for content operations commands available only in context menus (hyperlink remove, edit, etc.)

HyperlinkRemove.delete_web_link: Remove all hyperlinks from the document, keeping the display text.
HyperlinkRemove.delete_mailto: Remove all hyperlinks from the document, keeping the display text.

HyperlinkEdit.change_display_text_web: Change the display text of the first hyperlink to 'hello world'.
HyperlinkEdit.change_display_text_mailto: Change the display text of the email hyperlink to 'Jane'.
